title: DytchsEnd
description: Open & close The End for events with one command.
body:
DytchsEnd

Simple End plugin to open/close The End for events.

Lock The End until your event goes live, then open it to the whole server with a single command — complete with a server-wide announcement, portal blocking, and an optional sweep of stragglers back to spawn. Tiny, no-fuss, zero dependencies. --- ## ✨ Features - **One-command control** — `/dytchsend open` and `/dytchsend close`. The End starts **closed**, and the open/closed state survives restarts. - **Event-worthy announcements** — opening or closing broadcasts a chat message *plus* a big on-screen title and sound to everyone, so the moment is impossible to miss. - **Portal blocking** — while closed, players can't enter the End; they get a clean, throttled "closed" message at the portal instead. - **Sweep on close** — optionally teleport anyone still in the End back to spawn when you close it (configurable location, with an option to let staff stay). - **Bypass permission** — let staff into the End to set up while it's still closed. - **Fully configurable** — every message, the title + sound, the reminder interval, and the spawn point are editable. - **Lightweight** — one small jar, no dependencies. Paper **1.21+**. --- ## 📋 Commands | Command | Description | Permission | |---|---|---| | `/dytchsend open` | Open the End (announces it server-wide) | `dytchsend.admin` | | `/dytchsend close` | Close the End + sweep out stragglers | `dytchsend.admin` | | `/dytchsend status` | Show whether the End is open or closed | — | | `/dytchsend reload` | Reload the config | `dytchsend.admin` | **Aliases:** `/dend`, `/dytchend` --- ## 🔑 Permissions | Node | Default | Grants | |---|---|---| | `dytchsend.admin` | `op` | Open / close / reload the End | | `dytchsend.bypass` | `op` | Enter the End even while it's closed | --- ## ⚙️ Configuration The End starts **closed**. Open it with `/dytchsend open`, close it with `/dytchsend close` — the state persists across restarts. Everything is editable in `config.yml`: ```yaml
